Traditional types (is_traditional = true): article, book, book-chapter, book-review, conference-paper, data-paper, dissertation, editorial, erratum, letter, preprint, retraction, review, software-paper. Other types: conference-abstract, dataset, libguides, other, paratext, peer-review, reference-entry, report, software, standard, study-registration, supplementary-materials. paratext marks covers, tables of contents and similar records that frame a publication rather than carry its content. book-review, conference-abstract, conference-paper, data-paper and software-paper are recent additions with low coverage so far. Definitions: https://help.openalex.org/data/work-types/
